scope: Chapter 29 gives the strictly increasing Lee-curvature volume polynomial, the constant-least-eigenvalue semipositivity criterion and two explicit Hopf families in every dimension at least two. The proof reuses the established conformal Gauduchon nonvanishing argument. The semipositive representative also gives nefness and the balanced obstruction. Historical and research-program seams preserve the unrestricted P03 conjecture; indefinite Lee curvature and pointwise first degeneration do not refute it.
